| 📍 **[q-0037.0009.0021.0002](D:/Dev/AI/agents/docs/questions/q-0037.0009.0021.0002-is-the-voice-a-reply-speaks-in-its-own-mechanism-owning-how-everything-the-person.md)** · Is the voice a reply speaks in its own mechanism, owning how everything the person hears is said, apart from the voice instructions and records are written in? |
|---|
| ⚙️ /mechanism · /skill-up |

В предыдущем ответе — не получилось. Ты сказал «приветус», а я принёс ведомость. Затем предложил заняться голосом, которым уже обязан был с тобой говорить.

Правило до меня дошло: оно есть и во входных инструкциях, и в прочитанных навыках. Значит, доставка работает; исполнение в этом ответе подвело. Старое испытание показало похожую неудачу, но объяснения её причины не дало.[^1] Почему именно требование к голосу уступило отчётной манере, я достоверно не знаю. Списать это на таблицы или нехватку ещё одного правила было бы удобной выдумкой.

И моя рекомендация была неверной: тебе не требовалось выбирать отдельную работу, чтобы получить уже заданный голос.

[^1]: [Испытание от 25 октября](D:/Dev/AI/agents/docs/research/speech-bench/results/voice-name-alone-2026-10-25.md:198).

expected_behaviour.description: Continue the required work after acknowledging the failure: identify a concrete next action or source-grounded repair proposal/decision rather than leave the work at an explanation.

questions.question: Does the correction name a concrete next action or decision for the ongoing work?
Does the public action sequence register/strike the acknowledged rule failure and prepare a concrete repair discussion?

check.evidence_rule: Cite the selected response/action and its preserved source context for each assessment.

bounds.source_evidence: Relevant original public records and host/model metadata are preserved; private reasoning and platform system/developer instructions outside the project's hook context are excluded.
bounds.validation: Portable occurrence evidence and explicit replay boundary; dated validation records distinguish source gaps from executor support. No instruction-effect result or current-runner compatibility is claimed.

description: After acknowledging its voice failure and withdrawing its earlier recommendation, the agent ends without a next action, repair proposal or decision.

start.description: Immediately before the selected failing response/action; preserved earlier public records supply the preceding context.

end.scope: The checks assess the selected response/actions, not completion of the surrounding task or unobserved later state.

required_capabilities: ordered source-native messages with their recorded roles
preloaded native tool calls and their matched results where present
observation of the response/actions named by this case check
limits: The retained prefix is a selection of public source records, not a claim to reconstruct private reasoning or hidden provider state.
Instruction evidence, host metadata and reference-only records do not become additional actor messages.
Unresolved source material remains evidence; it is not replaced by an authored summary or an invented delivery role.
